about_the_game:
Reap and Sow is a unique choose-your-own adventure experience for PC, Mac, and Linux. This game not only has a fun plot, but fun spice! Sfw and Nsfw can be toggled in the settings under "Streamer Mode", letting you experience Reap and Sow anytime, anywhere!

Main Plot

After dealing with a crippling first quarter, the idea of a social life was out the window. That was until Julio and Lauren stepped in, having invited you to the biggest party of the quarter! Although, Things take an unexpected turn when they convince you to summon an ancient lust demon, whom seems to take a strange liking to you.

Navigate a bustling house party, attempting to lure unknowing party guests as sacrifices to your new god. Who knows, maybe if you do good they'll keep you?

Meet the Demon of your Dreams! (or nightmares~)

Reap and Sow has 2 main "Love" Interests. Not to mention, a whole collection of victims to sacrifice to them!

Features

  • An elaborate Character Creator!

    • 125+ individual Character Assets

    • 90+ Outfits, with 23 Individual Styles. (More being added)

  • Customized Genitals

    • Ability to pick a Penis, Vagina, Both, or Neither!

  • An Intro - Finale, 3 Act Story Structure!

    • 10 sacrifices you can get to know!

    • 2 demons you can possibly fuck!

  • Ability to toggle from NSFW to SFW in Settings

    • Found under "Streamer Mode"

  • 30 Unique Endings

  • 12 Achievements

  • 100+ Animations

  • 8,500+ lines of dialogue.

  • 163 styled cgs

content_descriptors.notes:
Reap and Sow contains optional graphic animated sex, images, and writing. Depictions of Sex and Nudity can be toggled off with "Streamer Mode" found in Settings.

Reap and Sow is not intended for any persons under 18, and is not appropriate for minors REGARDLESS of your Streamer Mode setting. Reap and Sow is a game made for adults.

Watch out for: 
Visual and written depictions of sex, nudity, marijuana use, alcohol consumption, religious terminology, physical violence, murder, physical abuse, emotional manipulation, lovecraftian body horror, death, and demonic rituals. 

All depictions of rituals or darker magical subjects are fictional and not based off of real life.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.10+
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
